title: Villa Serenidad | Ocean View Pool Retreat
description: Please be sure to click “Show more” to read the full listing description, including important details and house rules, before booking. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us - we’re happy to help and look forward to hosting you!The spaceVilla Serenidad is a spacious 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom private retreat in the beautiful beach town of Rincón, comfortably accommodating up to 10 guests. Nestled in the peaceful Puntas neighborhood, this two-level villa combines tropical serenity, ocean views, and modern comfort, creating the perfect escape for families and groups looking to unwind near some of Puerto Rico’s most stunning beaches and surf spots.Surrounded by lush greenery and designed to embrace indoor-outdoor living, the villa features expansive terraces, bright open spaces, and a private pool overlooking the tropical landscape and coastline. Whether you're enjoying your morning coffee with ocean breezes, spending the day poolside, or relaxing after a beach day, Villa Serenidad offers the ideal setting for a memorable island getaway.IMPORTANT NOTEPlease note that the lower level of the property is a completely separate private studio occupied by a long-term resident. This area does not have interior access to the main house or guest spaces, ensuring privacy for both guests and the resident. The resident does not have access to the pool or any of the outdoor amenities reserved exclusively for Villa Serenidad guests.PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTSPrivate poolOcean viewsGas BBQTwo-level villa with spacious layoutLibraryFully air-conditionedBackup generatorHigh-speed WiFiWasher & dryer for added convenienceParking for up to 4 cars1 king bed & 4 queen bedsLocated in the desirable Puntas area of RincónLIVING AREAUpon entering Villa Serenidad, you are welcomed by a bright and airy open-concept living space filled with natural light from large surrounding windows. The warm wood accents, tropical-inspired ceilings, and comfortable furnishings create a relaxed yet elevated atmosphere throughout the home.The living area features plush seating and a flat-screen TV, providing a cozy space to relax after a day exploring Rincón. Adjacent to the living room is the dining area, perfectly positioned to enjoy the lush tropical surroundings visible through the oversized windows.The villa’s thoughtful layout allows for seamless indoor-outdoor living, with easy access to the terrace and pool area from the main level.KITCHENThe fully equipped kitchen offers everything needed for a comfortable extended stay. Featuring modern appliances, spacious countertops, and a central island with seating, the kitchen is both functional and inviting for gathering and preparing meals together.It comes stocked with cookware, utensils, and essential appliances including a refrigerator, stovetop, microwave, dishwasher, coffee maker, and more to make cooking during your stay effortless.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSVilla Serenidad features 4 comfortable bedrooms spread across two levels, offering privacy and flexibility for larger groups.First Floor:- Bedroom 1: One queen bed- Bedroom 2: Two queen bedsSecond Floor:- Master Bedroom: One king bed with en-suite bathroom- Bedroom 4: One queen bed with private bathroomEach bedroom includes its own air-conditioning unit for personalized comfort.PACK AND PLAY (SUBJECT TO AVAILABILITY): We can leave a complimentary Pack and Play at the property upon request. This should be requested upon booking or no later than 5 days before arrival. Pack and Plays are subject to availability.ADDITIONAL DETAILSThe first floor includes the kitchen, living room, laundry room, two bedrooms, one full bathroom, one half bathroom, and direct access to the outdoor pool area. Upstairs, guests will find a quiet library space, the master suite, and an additional bedroom with its own bathroom.The villa also includes a backup generator for added peace of mind during your stay.POOL AREA AND OCEAN VIEWSVilla Serenidad features a private pool surrounded by lush tropical greenery and beautiful ocean views. The outdoor area also includes a gas BBQ, making it the perfect space to relax, enjoy the ocean breeze, and gather with family and friends in the peaceful atmosphere of Rincón.PLEASE DO NOTE THAT THE POOL IS NOT HEATED. The warm Caribbean weather naturally keeps the water enjoyable year-round.GETTING AROUND & PARKINGThis property is located in Rincón and you will need a car to explore the island and all the amazing beaches - Domes, María, Sandy, and Tres Palmas are all located within a short 5-10 minute drive from Villa Serenidad.Villa Serenidad has outdoor parking space for up to four (4) vehicles.LOCATIONVilla Serenidad is located in Bo. Puntas, one of Rincón’s most sought-after areas, known for its laid-back surf culture, beautiful beaches, and incredible sunsets. Guests will be just a short drive from popular beaches, local restaurants, cafés, and outdoor activities while still enjoying the privacy and tranquility of this tropical retreat.Rincón is a mecca for surfers of all levels, with beaches like María's, Sandy, Tres Palmas, and Domes offering fantastic waves. Domes Beach hosts an annual international surfing competition and various beach festivals. Beginners can take lessons at local surf schools - there's one at Sandy at another one at María's Beach.Beyond surfing, Rincón offers plenty of water activities. Explore the Tres Palmas Marine Reserve, known for its beautiful corals and diverse marine life, ideal for snorkeling. In winter, you might even spot humpback whales.For a more relaxed experience, enjoy a sunset boat ride followed by a beachside dinner. Visit the Punta Higüero Lighthouse, a historic landmark offering panoramic views of the sea and Domes Beach.Food enthusiasts will delight in Rincón's culinary scene. Try Cowboy's Cantina for delicious cuts of meat and rodeo nights. Explore the variety of food trucks offering South American cuisine, vegan options, and refreshing drinks.Start your day with breakfast at The English Rose, known for its delightful food and stunning views. Don't miss out on the local favorites like Jack's Shack and Carta Buena for a taste of Rincón's diverse flavors.With its array of activities and dining options, Rincón promises an unforgettable vacation experience at Villa Serenidad.Other things to noteSTARTER AMENITIESAt West Indies Vacation Rentals, we strive to provide top-notch amenities, ensuring our guests feel at home during their stay. All properties come with freshly laundered bed linens and towels. We provide 2 bath towels per guest and 1 beach/pool towel per guest.We provide a set of disposable essentials to help you get your vacation started comfortably. These include:- 1 set of hotel-size soap and shampoo (per bathroom)- 3 garbage bags- 1 roll of paper towels- 2 rolls of toilet paper (per bathroom)- 1 dish soap- 1 dish sponge- A small amount of laundry detergentPlease note that we do not provide unlimited disposable amenities. It is the guest’s responsibility to review what is included in the property and stock any additional items needed for the duration of the stay.Most properties also include at least 2 beach chairs and an ice cooler. You may reach out to us 5 days before arrival for confirmation. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT TIMESCheck-in begins at 4:00 PM, and since this is a self-check-in unit, you can arrive anytime after that.If you’d like to check in earlier, please contact us the day before your arrival, and we’ll confirm availability. When possible, early check-in typically starts around 11:00 AM. Please note that early check-in is subject to availability and depends on our cleaning schedule.If you need a guaranteed early check-in, you will need to book from the night prior to ensure the property is ready upon your arrival.Check-out time is at 11:00 AM. For late check-out requests, please reach out the day before your departure, and we’ll be happy to check availability for you.INSTANT & LAST-MINUTE BOOKING POLICYInstant Booking is available if reserved at least 2 days before check-in.For same-day or next-day reservations, availability depends on our cleaning schedule. You’re welcome to send a booking request, but please note that this does not guarantee the unit is booked—all requests must be reviewed and approved by our team. Requests sent late at night may not be reviewed until the following day, and same-day bookings are usually not accepted after 6:00 PM.We appreciate your understanding!HOUSE RULESNO SMOKING: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged if this rule is violated.NO PETS: While we are pet lovers, pets are not permitted at the property at any time. A $300 fine will be charged if this rule is violated, and guests may be asked to leave the property.QUIET HOURS: Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please be mindful of noise during these hours out of respect for nearby residents/neighbors.UTILITIES (WATER & ELECTRICITY): In the event of an interruption to water or electrical service, the host is not responsible for hotel, alternate lodging, or transportation expenses. If service is interrupted for more than 3 hours, guests may cancel the reservation and request a refund for unused nights only. Nights already used are non-refundable.MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY: The maximum occupancy is 10 adults/children at all times, including visitors. OCCUPANCY ENFORCEMENT: Occupancy limits are strictly enforced. Exceeding the maximum occupancy may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation or removal from the property without refund.TOWELS & LINENS: Towels and linens are provided for normal use only. Please do not use them for cleaning or allow them to be stained with food, grease, or other substances. Charges may apply for damaged or stained items. TOWEL HANGING: Please do not hang towels or any other items to dry in areas visible from outside the unit. A $100 community fine may apply if this rule is violated.SUBLETTING: Subletting or re-renting the property is not permitted.TRAVEL INSURANCE / HURRICANE SEASONWe strongly recommend that all guests purchase travel insurance, not only during the peak months of Hurricane Season (July to October) but also throughout the year to cover unexpected events such as travel delays, pandemics, or other unforeseen issues.Travel insurance is inexpensive and can reimburse travelers for most expenses associated with canceling travel outside of the cancellation window; however, coverage will depend on the policy purchased. Make sure to review and understand the options before purchase.DISCLAIMER: We are not associated with any travel insurance companies.INTERACTION WITH GUESTSWe want your stay at West Indies Vacation Rental to be smooth and enjoyable. You can message us anytime after booking with questions. Starting 5 days before arrival, your designated Property Manager will also be available to answer any additional questions you may have prior to arrival. You’ll get all the essential property information 48 hours before arrival, as well as the Property Manager’s direct contact, so you’ll have support when you need it - before, during, and after your stay.

title: VIEWS, Pool, Swim-up Bar, EV charger, Chef Kitchen
description: Escape to this spacious 5-bedroom home in Bo. Puntas—perfect for families and large groups. Enjoy plenty of room on the covered patios and the grand saltwater pool with ocean views. Relax on the oversized pool steps or sip a drink on the built-in bar stools. The chef’s kitchen features a jumbo island and touch-faucet sink, making meal prep a gathering spot for everyone.Please note: the living room projector and speaker system are not included in the listing.The spaceEnjoy panoramic views of the Caribbean Sea and Aguadilla Bay—perfect for large groups. The oversized pool steps are ideal for sunbathing, lounging, or playing with kids in the shallow area. All bedrooms have A/C, and the living room features eight ceiling fans with doors that open to let the Caribbean breeze flow through the great room. This home sleeps a maximum of 10 guests.Installed in July 2023, our premium water system provides high-quality, contaminant-free water with ozone, reverse osmosis, and UV sterilization. An additional pump ensures ideal pressure, and the kitchen faucet offers purified drinking water—no need to buy bottled water.The house also comes with a Pelaton bike, a set of hand weights and yoga mats. The garage has an EV charger for anyone traveling with an electric car.Guest accessThe laundry room is located on the ground floor next to the storage with beach chairs and other water equipment.The garage has an EV charger for anyone traveling across the island with an electric car. Guests have access to patio furniture, snorkel gear, pool floats, coolers, games, and a variety of kitchen spices and condiments.Please note: the ceiling projector and screen are not included as amenities and are off limits. A Smart TV is provided for guest use, and you’re welcome to sign in with your own streaming services.Other things to noteEnjoy both indoor and outdoor dining options, plus BBQ on the patio with sweeping Caribbean views. Each of the five bedrooms has its own A/C unit, luxury bedding, and a full bathroom for personal comfort. The home is equipped with beach chairs, snorkel gear, pool floats, coolers, bed linens, beach/bath towels, WiFi, a Smart TV with app access, a stocked kitchen, games, laundry facilities, a pack ’n play, and a high chair.Located on Puerto Rico’s western point: 2.5 hours from San Juan (SJU), 30 minutes from Aguadilla (BQN), Mayaguez (MAZ), and 1.5 hours from Ponce (PSE). To avoid the drive from San Juan, Cape Air offers multiple daily flights from SJU to MAZ.
